item.title: Kone Siteflow - Real-time digital tools for construction and building
item.description: Siteflow is a real-time 3D simulation platform designed for construction projects. It enables architects, engineers, and project managers to visualize and plan building sites in immersive detail, providing a comprehensive view of construction progress, resource allocation, and potential challenges before they arise.
